description: Repairs r-sql-13b/join-limit-tables: the 32-table nest timed out and lost the other cases. Asks where the number of table occurrences stops being accepted, and at which phase, with only the count varying: a comma cross join of n aliases of the one-row table One, for n = 32, 33, 34 and 50 in ascending order, each opened directly. The nested INNER JOIN form is in its own probe. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
